sql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT GAMES_GAME_ID, HOME_TEAM_ID, HOME_TEAM_WINS
  FROM NBA.TRANSFORMED.src_games
  WHERE SEASON = 2018
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY GAMES_GAME_ID ORDER BY GAMES_GAME_ID) = 1
)
SELECT
  t.TEAM_ID,
  t.TEAM_ABBREVIATION,
  ROUND(SUM(g.HOME_TEAM_WINS) / COUNT(g.GAMES_GAME_ID), 3) AS home_win_rate
FROM g
JOIN NBA.TRANSFORMED.dim_teams_cleansed t
  ON g.HOME_TEAM_ID = t.TEAM_ID
GROUP BY t.TEAM_ID, t.TEAM_ABBREVIATION
ORDER BY SUM(g.HOME_TEAM_WINS) / COUNT(g.GAMES_GAME_ID) DESC, t.TEAM_ABBREVIATION
LIMIT 1

sql:
WITH opp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT GAME_ID, TEAM_ID, TEAM_ABBREVIATION
  FROM NBA.RAW.raw_games_details
)
SELECT
  o.TEAM_ABBREVIATION,
  SUM(p.POINTS) AS total_points
FROM NBA.TRANSFORMED.local_player_game_facts p
JOIN opp o
  ON p.GAME_ID = o.GAME_ID
 AND p.OPPONENT_TEAM_ID = o.TEAM_ID
WHERE LOWER(p.PLAYER_NAME) = 'kevin durant'
GROUP BY o.TEAM_ABBREVIATION
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 1
